name: 74136 · Tulsa, OK
findings: ZIP 74136 (Tulsa) has 232 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74136 (Tulsa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 32 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
